mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona City Hall with a temperature of 63 degrees. Please be aware of a moderate air quality alert with an index of 57. The moon is currently a waxing gibbous, and there are no visible ISS sightings in our sky tonight.

The City Clerk's office is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for students in grades K through 12. Designs must be original, include the text I Voted, and be submitted by 4 PM on July 22. Four winners will be selected from different age categories to be featured on stickers for the November election.

We have plenty of fun happening today, including the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on July 27 or test your knowledge at trivia nights starting July 28.

In our weekly police update, officers reported that on July 13, a 36-year-old Madison man was arrested for his first offense O-W-I after a passerby alerted authorities to a vehicle stuck on a large rock.
You are going to love today's flavor, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The shop is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM, so make sure to stop by then.
